primary_decoupling.activity_to_decouple: Evaluate and choose a provider/product (fees, friction, transparency, convenience)
primary_decoupling.from_incumbent_bundle: Traditional incumbent banks that bundle product comparison/education with sales-led acquisition and onboarding across multiple touchpoints (including in-person), making it hard to evaluate options cleanly (E6).
primary_decoupling.customer_pain: Customers struggle to compare true costs and frictions across banks because information is opaque, sales-biased, and spread across channels; they often must invest time/effort before even knowing whether a product is a fit (E6, E7).
primary_decoupling.new_offering: Launch a Nubank “Financial Match + Pre-check” layer: an AI-guided comparison and eligibility pre-assessment that, in a few minutes, translates a customer’s goals into a transparent shortlist (Nubank + alternatives) and gives a clear next-best action, with one-tap handoff into Nubank onboarding if Nubank is the match (E4, E6).
primary_decoupling.why_customer_switches: They can keep their current banking setup while instantly getting a clearer, faster decision on “what should I choose?”—reducing evaluation effort now, and only switching the rest of the workflow if/when Nubank is the obvious fit; this aligns with Teixeira’s decoupling idea of “peeling away a portion of the customer’s value chain” (books/unlocking-the-customer-value-chain-chapter-1.md) rather than replicating the full bank bundle (E7, E6).

do_not_decouple.activity: Open the account and complete onboarding (identity/documents, activation, card issuance, initial setup)
do_not_decouple.reason: Avoid making this the next wedge: Nubank already proved differentiation via fully digital, branchless onboarding; re-decoupling here is incremental and distracts from taking the next weak-link activity upstream in choice/evaluation (E8).

do_not_decouple.activity: Conduct daily transactions (payments, transfers, withdrawals, deposits) and monitor balances/statements
do_not_decouple.reason: Do not unbundle or rebuild this as a new “multi-bank transactions” play; it is already a core Nubank experience (e.g., no-fee, real-time digital transactions), and diverting focus risks degrading the operational quality of the engine customers use daily (E9).

do_not_decouple.activity: Apply for, use, and repay credit products (credit card/loan) as needed
do_not_decouple.reason: Do not choose this as the next decoupling move: Nubank already differentiates with transparent, accessible credit products; pushing further here increases complexity and diverts attention from the lower-dependency, upstream evaluation layer that can acquire new customers earlier in the journey (E11, E4).

do_not_decouple.activity: Get help, resolve issues, and adjust account settings; escalate to physical touchpoints if needed
do_not_decouple.reason: Avoid building physical escalation/branch-like touchpoints as an “unbundled support” layer; Nubank’s advantage is 24/7 digital customer service, and moving into physical touchpoints adds cost and undermines the digital-first model (E10, E6).
